title: transformationmapping
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): createdby, createdonbehalfby, importmapid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby.

createdon.description: Date and time when the transformation mapping was created.

introducedversion.description: Version in which the component is introduced.

ismanaged.description: Information that specifies whether this component is managed.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the transformation mapping was last modified.

processcode.description: Information about whether the transformation mapping needs to be processed.

solutionid.description: Unique identifier of the associated solution.

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the transformation mapping.

targetentityname.description: Name of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 entity.

transformationmappingid.description: Unique identifier of the transformation mapping.

transformationmappingidunique.description: Unique identifier of the Transformation Mapping.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the transformation mapping.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the transformationmapping.

_importmapid_value.description: Unique identifier of the associated data map.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the mapping.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the transformationmapping.
